# Run.processGraph for a JSON-like graph and C# (provenance checked, as with
# --debug provenance): replace object type, flatten, combine classes (+
# cleanup), infer maps until unchanged, expand strings (infer), flatten,
# none to any, fixed point, make transformations, flatten, GC.
builder prov alpha stm=date:date-time,time:date-time,date-time,uuid,uri,integer-string,bool-string
prim i integer
prim d double
prim nul null
prim b bool
prim none none
str color cases=red:6,green:5,blue:4 n=Color
str color2 cases=red:3,green:2 n=Color
str ids cases=/uuid n=Id
str when cases=/date-time n=When
str count cases=/integer-string n=Count
str name cases=Ann:1,Bob:1,Cy:1 n=Name
union ni i,nul n=Age
cls p1 age:ni,color:color,id:ids,name:name,when:when n=Person
cls p2 age:d,color:color2,id:ids,name:name n=Person
cls p3 age:i,color:color,id:ids,name:name,when:when,extra:b n=Person
cls p4 age:i,color:color,id:ids,name:name,nick:name n=Boss
arr people p1
union pp p2,p3 n=Friend
arr friends pp
cls scores xqzvw:i,kwjhq:i,pfgtz:i,qqxzk:i n=Scores
arr empty none
cls top people:people,boss:p4,friends:friends,scores:scores,count:count,empty:empty n=Top
top Top top
finish printonrewrite
replaceobj
flatten conflate
combine alpha conflate
combine alpha same
infermaps conflate
infermaps conflate
expand infer
flatten conflate
nonetoany
fixedpoint
maketx csharp
flatten conflate
gc alpha
print
